title: items
summary: MSUI implements the template query pair, use/open/destroy/auto-equip/auto-store-bag/swap/swap-inv/split/set-ammo writers, item-push and strict inventory-failure parsing. Openable items use exact CMSG_OPEN_ITEM routing and pending locks; world-drop destruction uses the exact six-byte CMSG_DESTROYITEM body and a law-positioned DELETE_ITEM StaticPopup. Refusals resolve the complete build-5875 GlobalStrings table and unlock immediately. SMSG_ITEM_ENCHANT_TIME_UPDATE is strictly decoded into per-item/slot tooltip deadlines.

openItems.text: CMSG_OPEN_ITEM: absent - lockboxes/wrapped/openable items cannot be cracked open
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: added exact two-byte bag/slot writer, reference-ordered gift/quest/loot right-click fork, LOOTABLE/WRAPPER/instance-lock predicates, immediate gray lock for loot-opening items, and focused clinical coverage.

openItems.text: CMSG_DESTROYITEM (bag, slot, count): absent - items cannot be destroyed
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: added exact bag/slot/count/reserved-byte writer, world-drop detection, shared two-slot StaticPopup coordination, law-authored 420px alert geometry, Yes/No/Escape routing, pending slot lock, reset cleanup, and focused clinical coverage.

openItems.text: CMSG_AUTOSTORE_BAG_ITEM: absent (bag-to-bag auto-store; MSUI only has explicit swap/split)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: opcode 0x010B and the exact three-u8 source-bag/source-slot/destination-bag builder are exposed through WorldSession and NetworkClient and byte-pinned as FF1813. Like current Benilla's builder-only scope, this adds no new bag presentation or invented click route.

openItems.text: SMSG_INVENTORY_CHANGE_FAILURE: no handler - every refused move/equip fails silently with no red error text
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: strict conditional-body parser, live dispatch, complete build-5875 error-key mapping, GlobalStrings formatting, pending-lock clear, and UIErrorsFrame delivery implemented and clinically checked.

openItems.text: SMSG_ITEM_ENCHANT_TIME_UPDATE: no handler (temporary enchant countdown updates dropped)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: exact guid/slot/seconds/player parser and live dispatch now maintain per-item/slot deadlines, including the zero-second clear branch, with focused malformed-body coverage.
